answer: What I'd try is having graders compare instead of score. Each seat shows two answers to the same task, say two takes on an orchard frost plan or a basalt quarry survey, and you just pick the better one. Every answer gets about 20 matchups with random graders and is ranked Elo style. A farm can't wave its clones through by voting yes, since each win it hands out is someone else's loss, and most matchups land with strangers. Owning 10% of graders, its junk still loses most of the way on its voyage up the rankings.
